## Composes

This box is a COMPLETE instance of each of these tiers at once (ADR 0039) — it does not
merely resemble them, and the fleet reads one capacity row per layer rather than one per box:

- [`blackwell-16`](blackwell-16.md)
- [`blackwell-2x16`](blackwell-2x16.md)

Placement decides per task which LAYER and seat serve it, and records that decision on
every result (`placed`). A layer marked dormant is declared but never routed to until the
operator enables it; an opt-in layer is entered only on an explicit ask, under its guards.

| layer | tier | devices | seats | guards | state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `single` | `blackwell-16` | `0` / `2` | router (device 0) — the cascade's own rungs<br>agent → `gemma-4-26b-agent` (device 0, window 131072)<br>ocr → `qwen3-vl-8b` (device 2, window 16384)<br>stt → `whisper-stt` (device 2) | — | active |
| `pair` | `blackwell-2x16` | `0,2` | agent → `qwen3.8-27b` (device 0,2, window 131072)<br>long → `qwen3.8-27b-262k` (device 0,2, window 262144)<br>vision → `qwen3-vl-32b` (device 0,2, window 16384) | — | opt-in |
| `display` | `blackwell-16` | `1` | router (device 1): triage → `gemma-4-e2b-display`, workhorse → `gemma-4-e4b-display` | display_floor, presence (display device 1, floor 4 GiB) | **dormant** (operator enables) |
| `triple` | `blackwell-3x16` | `2,1,0` | agent → the tier's vLLM seat | — | active |

## Agent seat

This tier declares a persistent **vLLM** agent seat, and the installer RENDERS it — the
llama-swap entry, the start/stop wrappers and the harness `agent_model` binding all derive from
one declaration, so the seat and the lane routing to it cannot disagree.

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| id | `qwen3.8-27b-vllm-3card` | the llama-swap model id, `--served-model-name`, and what `agent_model` binds to |
| cards | `2,1,0` | `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, in PCI order |
| tensor_parallel | 0 | `--tensor-parallel-size`; tensor x pipeline must equal how many cards are listed |
| pipeline_parallel | 3 | `--pipeline-parallel-size`: the model is split across the cards in listed order |
| layer_partition | `28,13,23` | layers per pipeline stage (`VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION`), in card order |
| kv_cache_memory_bytes | 4026531840 | fixed KV budget per card (`--kv-cache-memory-bytes`) instead of a profiled share: how a seat on a display card leaves the desktop its room |
| max_model_len | 262144 | the served window |
| gpu_memory_utilization | 0.84 | the engine's share of the card — chosen WITH the seat's co-residents in mind, not alone |
| kv_cache_dtype | `fp8` | KV precision — backend-dependent, not free everywhere |
| ttl_seconds | 300 | idle window before the seat unloads and frees its cards |
| launch | `windows-wsl` | which artifact set starts it |
| fallback | `qwen3.8-27b` | the llama.cpp seat a box WITHOUT the vLLM venv serves instead |

### Cache server

This seat is backed by a KV **cache server**: a context that leaves VRAM comes back from
the store instead of being recomputed, and it survives a seat swap.

| setting | value |
|---|---|
| store | `fs_native` |
| address | `/mnt/kvcache/lmcache-seat-3card-fp8` |
| chunk_size | 1568 — must equal the engine's unified block size at this KV dtype |
| l1_staging_gb | 16 |
| key_prefix | `qube-seat-3card-fp8` |
| min_mbps | 200 — below this the seat DEGRADES to the same-box L1 tier, loudly (0.115.1); it never refuses to start |

The store is a second device and stays **optional**: a box without one runs the seat on
VRAM plus the L1 staging buffer.

> THE FLAGSHIP (operator 2026-09-19: "the 3 card tier as the agent seat now and the 2 card tier to be the opt in one ... biggest context window and keeps the LMCache server ... leave around 20% of the 5070ti free ... gpu 0 gets a bit less load than gpu 2"). Measured 2026-09-21 in the W1 campaign (8 sweeps, vLLM 0.28.0 + LMCache MP with the PR #4253 overlay, fp8 e4m3 KV) on the 3-card reference workstation (5060 Ti = CUDA 0 and 2, 5070 Ti = CUDA 1, the display card). Qwen3.8-27B-INT4 has 64 layers, 4 KV heads (so TP3 is impossible: pipeline), full attention every 4th layer, and an UNTIED bf16 lm_head (248,320 x 5,120 = 2.37 GiB) — the last stage carries it and the first carries the embedding (2.37) plus the vision tower (0.86). Order 2,1,0 puts the 5070 Ti in the MIDDLE, where it holds neither; order 0,1,2 failed LMCache register_kv_caches on the card-2 last rank twice. 28 layers per rank is the ceiling for a 262,144 window at 3.75 GiB of KV per card (pool 269,676; 29 layers caps it at 235,200). Card 0's compute = 23 layers + lm_head (~3 layer-equivalents) = 26 < card 2's 28. The 5070 Ti keeps 18-22% free with a 2.6-3.3 GB desktop and ~13% with a 4.1 GB one: the seat's own share is ~10 GB, most of it fixed per-process cost (vLLM + NCCL + the LMCache server's context), not layers. Needle 23.7k: cold 16.6 s, warm 0.48 s. L1 staging 16 GB is required, not a default (raised from 8 on 2026-09-22): this hybrid model stores ~205 MB per 1568-token chunk, a 2 GB L1 failed its stores, and 8 GB at the 0.80 watermark left too little free to stage an L2 hit back (short by 10 blocks). L2 SERVES: the evict phase got 0 external hits until the per-rank layout overlay patch (each pipeline rank's KV layout bound to its own pages); with it the cache-server store serves L2 hits back to the pipeline seat. One caveat stays open: the FIRST request after an MP server start gets 0 L2 hits (and recomputes) until register-time binding lands. chat_template qwen3-fold-system.jinja (shipped under setup/templates/vllm-seat/chat-templates/) folds 2+ leading system messages into one, which the upstream template rejects with a 400; a single-system prompt renders byte-identically. enable_prompt_tokens_details reports cached_tokens per request. The 2-card pair (tp2 on 0,2, 163,840) stays served as the opt-in agent-pool-2card seat; this schema holds one vLLM seat per tier (register A-113), so the pair is declared in the layers below and wired by hand. Records: plans/offload-harness/2026-09-21-wiring-debt/, /root/g7/w1/results/.

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> LONG WINDOW WIRED 2026-09-10 (operator: the third card buys CONTEXT, and the tier must register more than the 2-card tier): long_ctx_size 262144 = the `qwen3.8-27b-262k` twin the reference box serves live (q8_0 KV, no MTP, pinned to the 5060 Ti pair; KV upgraded q4_0->q8_0 2026-09-01, ledger G3) and the 3-card vLLM seat measured at 262,144 with fp8 KV (Nightshift 2 seat v7, needle fidelity PASS x3; 238,592 served at batched 3135 in the seat program) - the vLLM long layer ships with the composite tier (0.116.0). agent_ctx_tokens 262144 = the served window of the declared vLLM seat, the 3-card pipeline agent seat (was 163840 for the 2-card seat and 131072 before that: contracts were sized to 80 percent of the seat). Config #17 (3x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB = 48.9 GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5060 Ti @17:00.0 + RTX 5070 Ti @65:00.0 + RTX 5060 Ti @B5:00.0, X299 / i9-10980XE, quad-channel DDR4-3400 128GB). SHIPPED 0.113.32 (2026-09-07) after the operator asked three times. Before this tier existed the fleet's MOST-measured machine had no tier id at all and Get-Profile filed it as `dual-gpu` -- a tier no hardware has ever run and that the installer refuses to install (CUDA 13 cannot compile sm_70) -- so a fresh install on the box that produces most of the fleet's numbers would have seeded a pure projection. THE THIRD CARD BUYS CONTEXT AND CONCURRENCY, NOT A BIGGER POOLED MODEL (operator directive). Measured: llama.cpp's 3-way aggregate ceiling is 134.4 tok/s at c32 against the pair's 110-120 (+10-20%), and pipeline-parallel vLLM is about 8% SLOWER single-stream than tensor-parallel on two cards because the stages serialize. What it actually buys is KV pool -- 137,898 tokens across three cards versus 78,506 across two -- and headroom. PLACEMENT LAW, measured and load-bearing: anything that fits two cards runs on the 5060 Ti PAIR (devices 0 and 2); the RTX 5070 Ti is the DISPLAY card and stays interactive-first, joining only for over-2-card work, under a >=4 GiB desktop floor, and never while the operator is at the desk -- on 2026-09-04 a 3-card engine at util 0.87-0.90 left it under 1 GB, Windows fell to a 720p-class mode and the operator had to reboot (clean event log, no TDR: starvation, not a crash). The template pins NOTHING to device 1 and a render test asserts it. PIN BY GPU UUID, NEVER INDEX: two of the three cards report the identical board name 'RTX 5060 Ti', and CUDA/ComfyUI ordering does not match nvidia-smi PCI order. AGENT SEAT = THE 3-CARD PIPELINE SEAT (operator order 2026-09-19, wired 2026-09-21): the vllm_seat above, 262,144 context, fp8 KV, L1 16 GB. An earlier 3-card vLLM seat (fp16 KV, a fixed 3 GiB cache) FAILED the delegation gate -- a digest contract DEFERRED at 300,010 ms where the two-card seat finished it in 272 s -- and this paragraph once kept the agent lane on the 2-card pair for that reason; the fp8 re-measurement replaced it, and the 2-card pair is now the opt-in agent-pool-2card seat. THE 3-CARD OPT-IN SEATS WERE REMOVED 2026-09-10 (0.115.4) BY OPERATOR RULE: qwen3.8-flash-next (ncmoe28 / --tensor-split 28,10,10, measured 12.5-12.9 tok/s) and its native-262k twin (ncmoe32) parked 28-32 expert layers in host RAM, and RAM IS OVERFLOW ONLY -- no model keeps the bulk of its weights in host memory; long context on this tier is the pair's qwen3.8-27b-262k. CUDA graphs are ON for the 26B seats (measured 2026-09-05: gen 41.4 -> 58.0 and 39.0 -> 58.8 tok/s, output identical); GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT stays off (changes output, crashes the MTP 12b). MEDIA: ComfyUI does not shard a DiT, so extra cards buy parallel renders and weight-donor storage, never a bigger single render -- the bf16 LTX transformer still OOMs on the COMPUTE device's activations at 1920x1088, which a donor card cannot fix, and int8 DiTs cannot compute on a non-default CUDA device at all (ComfyUI-MultiGPU #220), so videogen COMPUTE is pinned to cuda:0 as a documented law exception (its weight donor is cuda:2). Evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-31-48gb-gates-NOTES.md, 2026-09-01-vllm-lmcache-results/, 2026-09-03-seat-optimization-program.md, 2026-09-05-cudax/. NOT to be confused with blackwell-48, which is ONE RTX PRO 5000 48GB card. MEDIA PLACEMENT CORRECTED 2026-09-07 (0.113.33) TO THE MEASURED LIVE PLACEMENT: this tier's ENTIRE media block was a byte-for-byte copy of blackwell-2x16's, whose gpu_env map is 0=utility / 1=FAST. On THREE cards the gpu_env map is 0=5060 Ti / 1=5070 Ti DISPLAY / 2=5060 Ti, so the copy pinned the vision seat onto the display card and named card 2 nowhere -- which is the whole reason the 3-card box measured no media difference from the 2-card box. It was an unadapted copy, not a hardware finding. TWO DEVICE ORDERINGS ARE IN PLAY AND THE DISPLAY CARD HAS A DIFFERENT INDEX IN EACH -- gpu_env is CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES under CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID (display = 1), while the ComfyUI pool keys are 'cuda:N' in ComfyUI's FASTEST-FIRST order (display = cuda:0, the pair = cuda:1/cuda:2). Applied, matching what the reference box actually runs (verified in both live config files and the live llama-swap header): vision seat CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 1 -> 2 and STT 0 -> 2, the 2026-08-31 G1 singles rebalance that moved whisper, vl-8b/ocr and the embed/rerank alternates to 5060Ti#2 while the cascade + memory-stack residents stayed on card 0 (re-measured 2026-09-05: vl-8b 11,751 MiB on card 2); imagegen_pool_compute cuda:0 -> cuda:1 with donor cuda:2, the pair, bf16 and re-verified there after the 2026-09-01 revert with two 1568x880 Krea 2 Turbo stills. VIDEOGEN COMPUTE IS UNCHANGED AND MUST STAY cuda:0: an int8 DiT cannot compute on a non-default CUDA device (ComfyUI-MultiGPU #220) and the 2026-09-01 attempt to move it threw cudaErrorIllegalAddress mid-render, so its compute genuinely belongs on the display card as a documented law exception. Do not 'restore' the vision seat to device 1: at 11,751 MiB it would leave ~3.5 GiB after the ~0.5-1.5 GB DWM tax, under the >=4 GiB desktop floor set by the 2026-09-04 starvation (720p-class mode, reboot, clean event log). Operator decision 2026-09-07: the 5070 Ti is CONTEXT/KV ONLY -- it may grow the KV pool for long-context seats (137,898 tokens across three cards vs 78,506 across two) and the named opt-in over-2-card seats may span it, but no tier seat is pinned to it. Gated by TestTripleBlackwellNeverSchedulesOntoTheDisplayCard (profiles.json, both orderings) and by two placement assertions in setup/render.tests.ps1 (rendered yaml). VISION SEAT UPGRADED 2026-09-08 (0.113.35): qwen3-vl-8b -> qwen3-vl-32b for VISION, with the 8B KEEPING OCR. This is a quality binding and the tier was shipping the loser of its own bake-off. 48 GB gates on the reference box: visioncanary MMMU 0.740 vs the 8B's 0.630 (+11 points, clears the >=8 promotion bar) -> the 32B takes vision; DocVQA ANLS 0.928 (-3.7) plus a dense-transcription regression -> the 8B keeps OCR. The split is itself quality-driven: each role goes to the model that measured better AT THAT ROLE, which is why this must not be collapsed back to one seat. The decision was APPLIED on the box (both live config files bind vision_model=qwen3-vl-32b and ocr_model=qwen3-vl-8b, and the running llama-swap serves both) and the tier table was simply never updated, so every fresh install of the tier whose reference box IS that machine got a measured 11-point MMMU regression. Flags are the measured ones: -sm tensor --tensor-split 25,25 on the 5060 Ti pair (CUDA-X 2026-09-05 moved it from -sm layer at the same split and got BYTE-IDENTICAL output 5/5 on a fixed image+prompt while generation went 19.6 -> 34.1 t/s -- identical output is what makes it free rather than a trade), --image-min-tokens 1024 as the visual-token FLOOR, and Qwen3-VL's official sampler (temp 0.7 / top-p 0.8 / top-k 20) pinned as a set. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2 -- a 32B does not fit one 16 GB card and device 1 is the display card. NOT PROPAGATED TO blackwell-2x16: this seat spans BOTH cards of its pair, and on the 2-card tier the second card is the one paying the desktop/DWM tax, so a 2-card box would be asked to give ~25 GB of its 32 GB to a swappable vision seat. That tier needs its own fit measurement before it inherits this. Gated by TestTripleBlackwellVisionSeatIsTheMeasuredWinner. MEDIA ROSTER AUDITED AND GATED 2026-09-14 (0.118.1, A-15): the 48 GB bake-off (`2026-08-31-48gb-bakeoff-renders/`) ran the whole media lane on this box and the tier shipped a media block copied byte-for-byte from blackwell-2x16; PR #264 corrected the PLACEMENTS and #266 the vision MODEL, but nothing gated what the bake-off DECIDED about models and precision, so the roster could drift back into a copy without failing anything. Slot by slot: vision = qwen3-vl-32b on the pair (MMMU +11); ocr = qwen3-vl-8b on card 2 (the 32B regressed: DocVQA -3.7 plus dense transcription); stt = whisper large-v3-TURBO on card 2 (turbo wins or ties every group, es-long WER 0.0652 vs 0.0838, at ~2x the speed, so the proposed stt_hq lane FAILED and stays empty); imagegen = Krea 2 TURBO bf16 at 8 steps / cfg 1 on pool cuda:1 + donor cuda:2 (Turbo bf16 came back pristine on all four prompts, while Krea 2 RAW is BROKEN on ComfyUI 0.34.0 under every recipe tested - int8 and bf16, euler+er_sde over simple/normal, raw_dynamic shift, AuraFlow 3.1 - composition correct and buried in terminal noise where the same-seed Turbo render is clean, so RAW is a fine-tuning base and not a servable lane); videogen = LTX-2.5 int8-convrot with the CONV video VAE on compute cuda:0 + donor cuda:2 (round 2 of the decoder A/B held seed, prompt, sampler, resolution and placement constant and changed only the VAE: conv resolved more detail on every one of 5 pairs, +15-25% Laplacian energy and +9-11% high-frequency, start-frame fidelity a wash at 0.02-0.26 dB, AND conv was 12-15% faster - it wins on both measurable axes; cuda:0 remains the documented ComfyUI-MultiGPU #220 exception, not a preference). ONE SLOT HAS NO WINNER AND WAS LEFT ALONE: TTS. Chatterbox v3 and both Spanish packs transcribe back verbatim through the whisper seat (intelligibility proven, loudness -16..-18 LUFS, the es-es pack peaking +0.2 dBFS), but naturalness was explicitly left as an operator A/B and adoption needs a contained-venv bump, so the seed is unchanged and the gate says nothing about it. Gated by TestTripleBlackwellMediaRosterIsTheMeasuredOne. FAN-OUT TWIN WIRED 2026-09-14 (0.118.1, A-70): the llama.cpp 27B seat shipped `--parallel 1` and is FLAT under fan-out - 34.6-37.4 tok/s aggregate at c1..c32, and it answers 429 from c16 (6 of 16 and 22 of 32 requests failed in the baseline arm). The measured operating point on the SAME pair is `--parallel 8` at the SAME `-c` (arm par8-pair, 2026-09-01, `llamacpp-par8-pair.json`, ledger "FAIRNESS ARM par8-pair"): W1 43.4 tok/s (unchanged single-stream) and aggregate 78.7 / 110.8 / 100.7 / 106.8 at c4/8/16/32, 0 failures - about 3x aggregate under fan-out. IT SHIPS AS A SEPARATE ENTRY, `qwen3.8-27b-par8`, NOT as a flag on the seat, and that is the whole decision: llama.cpp divides `-c` among its slots, so eight slots at --ctx-size 131072 serve 16,384 tokens EACH. The same night's Lenovo arm proves the mechanism in-house (`--parallel 8 -c 32768`: "16k/32k prompts exceed the 4k/slot window"). Putting `--parallel 8` on the seat itself would therefore cut this tier's declared fallback agent lane (fallback_agent_model qwen3.8-27b, fallback_agent_ctx_tokens 131072) to 16,384 while the profile still advertised 131,072 - the advertise-more-than-you-serve defect that shipped once already on blackwell-8. Both entries are swappable alternatives at ttl 300, so the twin costs nothing until something asks for it. NOT --parallel 16: on this pair it FAILS TO START at `-c 131072` (5.0 GB recurrent-state cache) and at `-c 65536`, and needs `-c 49152` + `--tensor-split 27,23` to run at all, for 119 vs 111 at c16. NOT --parallel 32: infeasible, ~350 MB of GDN recurrent state PER SLOT (an 11.3 GB rs buffer beside ~9 GB of weights on a 16 GB card). Gated by TestPairSpanningTemplatesShipTheMeasuredFanoutTwin. The three-card arm is not what ships: par8-3c (tensor-split 17,16,17, `-c 65536`) reached 102.9 tok/s at c8 against the pair's 110.8 AND it spans the display card, which the placement law forbids - so the twin is pair-pinned (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2) like every other default seat here. COMPOSITE (0.116.0, ADR 0039): composes blackwell-16 and blackwell-2x16 as layers single (cards 0|2) and pair (0,2), plus a DORMANT display layer for the small cascade rungs (the operator flips dormant:false after reading the G1b measurement); placement is recorded on every result as placed; the pair's long seat qwen3.8-27b-262k takes window overflow (pp 1,197 t/s) only when the pair's agent seat is idle. The TRIPLE layer carries the AGENT seat: the 3-card vLLM pipeline seat (vllm_seat above, 262,144 context) stands for it, entirely inside VRAM. The RAM-is-overflow-only rule of 2026-09-10 still removed the Flash-Next arms (0.115.4), and context_class long still resolves to the pair's 262k twin.
